entries.66c4af412edaec41: Under its management philosophy, the company's basic policy is to respond quickly to changes in the business environment, change its business model and structure, and realize growth and expansion of the group. In the Drug Discovery Support Business, the company plans to strengthen the provision of high value-added services that differentiate it from competitors, and in the Investment and Consulting Business, it intends to pursue the discovery of new investment targets in the business succession and turnaround fields. The company states that it will pursue a Hybrid-type business model that makes use of the characteristics of both businesses.
